Chapter 2 - Finder Objects

Using Object Class Definitions

Object class definitions describe what objects that belong to a particular class have in common. Each definition contains at least five kinds of information: properties, element classes, commands handled, default value class returned, and one or more examples. These categories are briefly described here, using examples from the definition of File that begins on page 60.

For a more detailed discussion of object classes and references to objects, see the AppleScript Language Guide.
